work_objective: Create 拾页, a single-page personal reading list at the repository root in one file, index.html, using only native HTML/CSS/JavaScript. The page shows the reading list as its primary surface, provides an add form accepting both title and author, allows toggling each entry between read and unread, provides an unread filter (with a way to view all), and persists the list including read state in browser localStorage so entries and states survive a page refresh. The entry point remains index.html opened directly as a static browser page; no build step, framework, CDN, account, cloud sync, or additional files are introduced. Inline CSS/JS live inside index.html only.
